text: The Patriots' season narrative flipped decisively in Week 4 when Drake Maye led a game-winning drive to stun the Bills 29-26 at the new Highmark Stadium, becoming the first team to win in Buffalo's brand-new building and pulling New England back from the brink of a 1-3 collapse. Maye, who had struggled early in the season, shook off two turnovers by throwing three touchdown passes in the comeback victory—a resilience that Coach Mike Vrabel deemed critical for the defending AFC East champions. The performance sparked broader questions about whether the Patriots, alongside the Rams and Cowboys who pulled off their own stunning Week 4 rallies, have genuinely turned their seasons around at 2-2, though observers are wisely cautious about crowning them fully back on track after their rough start. Beat writers highlighted the drive itself and Maye's ability to overcome early mistakes as the defining takeaway from what was ultimately a thrilling upset that gave New England genuine hope heading into the second half of the season.
